reviews.text:
Great app but... This app is efficient and easy to use. You can figure out what kind of plant you have my taking a photo of it. You can also figure out what’s wrong with your plant by taking a photo of it. It’ll give you a list of possible things that could be wrong and give you instructions on how to fix those issues. Taking an image to find out what kind of plant you have will also give you information on it like how often it should be watered, if it takes moderate or light care, if it requires a lot of sunlight or indirect sunlight, etc etc. But my only issue with the app is that when you’re able to see how often your plant should be watered, you also have the ability to set reminders for whatever time frame your plant needs to be watered in. When receiving that reminder, you get a notification that says something along the lines of “your plant needs water.” Nothing specific to let you know which plant. Once you open the notification, it brings you to your watering your plants reminder page which wouldn’t be a problem if you had one plant. I have a 6 plants. Which means the only way to tell which of my plants needs watering is by mathing it out every time. I have to check what I have my plants set to and count the days to check which plant I’m supposed be water. 
Super annoying. 
Just add which plant requires watering to the notification!!! 
Please make this change and I’ll stay on this app until I stop growing plants.
